question: What is the meaning of ability of the product to be reused by applying cascading principles to material application in relation to reuse?
data_point: ability of the product to be reused by applying cascading principles to material application
description:
The ability of the product to be reused by applying cascading principles to material application in relation to reuse means that the product can be used multiple times in different locations or for different purposes without losing its value or functionality. This approach maximizes material use and ensures that materials remain in use for as long as possible, contributing to a circular economy. <|ENDINPUT>
